syscalls.comment: Block dangerous syscalls for code execution sandbox (D-08)
Block clone with namespace flags (CLONE_NEWUSER|CLONE_NEWNS|CLONE_NEWPID|CLONE_NEWNET|CLONE_NEWIPC|CLONE_NEWUTS). Thread creation (unmasked clone) remains allowed for java/node/python.

_comments.D-21_syscalls: wait4, times, getrusage -- used by /usr/bin/time for memory tracking. Allowed by SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default.
_comments.D-22_syscalls: openat, write, unlink -- used for stderr temp files (sandbox-stderr-*.log). Allowed by SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default.
_comments.D-15_strategy: SCMP_ACT_ALLOW default with explicit blocks. Does NOT replace Docker's default -- this IS the full profile. Only dangerous syscalls are blocked.
